throughline.zh: NVIDIA 公布台灣測試、載板與光學引擎擴產計畫，聯電和愛普推進封裝內供電驗證，台灣記憶體勞資進程與晶圓廠零組件替代評估則提供不同的製造執行資訊。
throughline.en: NVIDIA detailed Taiwan-linked test, substrate and optical-engine expansion, UMC and AP Memory advanced in-package power validation, and separate labor and equipment sourcing developments affect semiconductor manufacturing operations.

text.zh: NVIDIA 公布京元電 11 億美元產能預付款，矽品光學引擎規劃 2027 年中提升至 15 倍；產能仍屬未來目標。
text.en: NVIDIA disclosed a US$1.1B KYEC capacity advance and SPIL's 15-fold optical-engine target for mid-2027; these are future milestones.

text.zh: 聯電與愛普 10 月 22 日宣布 DTC 矽電容合作，Gen2D 已完成初步晶圓驗證，系統級測試仍待進行。
text.en: UMC and AP Memory announced DTC silicon-capacitor collaboration on Oct 22; Gen2D initial wafer validation is complete, with system testing ahead.

text.zh: 美光桃園工會 11 名幹部 22 日展開罷工，公司同日公布季度分潤與勞退 10% 提撥；產量影響未知。
text.en: Eleven Micron Taoyuan union officers began a strike as the company unveiled quarterly bonuses and 10% retirement contributions; output effects are unknown.

text.zh: NVIDIA 發布 DSX POD，台灣 ODM 及電源供應商列名；備妥場址最快 14 天部署是公司估計。
text.en: NVIDIA launched DSX POD with Taiwan ODM and power partners; 14-day prepared-site deployment is a company estimate.

title.zh: NVIDIA 公布京元電 11 億美元預付款，矽品光學引擎規劃增產 15 倍
title.en: NVIDIA details $1.1B KYEC reservation advance and SPIL 15-fold optical-engine capacity target

summary.zh: NVIDIA 10 月 21 日在柏林 GTC 宣布，規劃以 11 億美元測試產能預訂預付款支持京元電美國新廠，目標 2027 年 4 月量產；矽品台灣 CPO 光學引擎產能目標 2027 年中提升至現有 15 倍。欣興台灣 KF 載板擴產預定 2027 年第 2 季起增加產能，均為未來計畫。
summary.en: At GTC Berlin on October 21, NVIDIA disclosed a US$1.1 billion testing-capacity reservation advance supporting KYEC's planned U.S. facility, targeting high-volume production in April 2027. SPIL aims for a 15-fold optical-engine capacity increase in Taiwan by mid-2027, while Unimicron plans to begin adding KF substrate capacity in Q2 2027; all are future milestones.

text.zh: 公告跨越晶片載板、晶圓級封裝、測試與光學引擎。京元電提供晶片測試，矽品負責 CPO 光學引擎，欣興提供先進封裝載板；NVIDIA 並預期 2027 年集團半導體測試產能較 2026 年翻倍，包含美國、台灣與新加坡擴充。
text.en: The disclosure spans package substrates, advanced packaging, testing and optical engines. KYEC supplies chip-testing services, SPIL focuses on CPO optical engines and Unimicron on advanced substrates. NVIDIA expects total testing capacity in 2027 to double versus 2026 across U.S., Taiwan and Singapore expansion.

text.zh: NVIDIA 表示新加坡測試產能計畫 2027 年 2 月開始大規模生產；矽品產能於 2028 年底前另力求再翻倍。與京元電的 11 億美元為產能預訂預付款，不能列為已完成廠房投資或公司營收。
text.en: NVIDIA targets February 2027 for expanded high-volume testing in Singapore and a further doubling of SPIL optical-engine capacity by end-2028. The US$1.1 billion is a reservation advance, not confirmed completed factory spending or recognized revenue.

text.zh: 各項基準月產量、設備到廠、客戶驗收、實際預付款撥付與投產率未公布。
text.en: Absolute base capacities, equipment installation, qualification, cash disbursement and realized utilization have not been disclosed.

title.zh: 聯電與愛普合作矽電容，Gen2D 已完成投片和初步驗證
title.en: UMC and AP Memory team on silicon capacitors after Gen2D tape-out validation

summary.zh: 聯電與愛普 10 月 22 日在新竹宣布深溝槽電容（DTC）晶圓製造與 S-SiCap 矽電容設計合作。愛普 Gen2D 產品已於第三季完成投片和初步功能驗證，後續將進行封裝基板系統級效能與可靠度測試；雙方尚未宣布客戶量產驗收。
summary.en: UMC and AP Memory announced a deep-trench-capacitor foundry and S-SiCap design collaboration in Hsinchu on October 22. AP Memory's Gen2D completed tape-out and initial functional validation in Q3, with substrate-level system performance and reliability tests next; customer production acceptance has not been announced.

text.zh: DTC 矽電容可配置於晶片附近、中介層、封裝基板或封裝底部，降低供電路徑阻抗，與既有 PCB 上的穩壓元件形成不同整合層級。這項合作連結晶圓代工、先進封裝、電容元件與資料中心晶片供電完整性。
text.en: DTC silicon capacitors can sit near compute dies, within interposers and substrates or on package landsides, moving capacitance closer to the load. The collaboration links foundry process technology, advanced packaging and data-center power integrity.

text.zh: 聯電提供可擴充晶圓製程，愛普提供客製化矽電容與系統整合。公司表示也在探索內埋中介層電容及封裝底部電容產品線；相關新製造投資尚未公布金額。
text.en: UMC provides scalable foundry processing while AP Memory supplies capacitor designs and system integration. They are exploring embedded interposer and landside capacitor variants; no budget was disclosed for associated new manufacturing capacity.

text.zh: 系統級測試結果、耐壓電容規格、量產良率、客戶導入時點與擴建金額未公布。
text.en: System-level test results, voltage and capacitance specifications, yields, customer adoption timing and expansion spending are undisclosed.

title.zh: 追蹤：美光桃園 11 名工會幹部罷工，公布季度分潤及勞退調升
title.en: Follow-up: 11 Micron Taoyuan union officers strike as company details quarterly bonuses

summary.zh: 美光桃園工會 11 名幹部 10 月 22 日上午 9 時起展開 24 小時罷工，台中工會則已於前一天達成協議。美光同日公布季度分潤獎金採現金與股票各半，台灣員工勞退提撥率由 8% 提高至 10%，並增 3 天有薪假；實際產線損失仍未披露。
summary.en: Eleven Micron Taoyuan union officers began a 24-hour strike at 9 a.m. on October 22, a day after the separate Taichung union reached an agreement. Micron announced quarterly profit-linked bonuses paid half in cash and half in equity, raised Taiwan retirement contributions from 8% to 10% and added three paid-leave days; production effects were not disclosed.

text.zh: 桃園廠牽涉 DRAM 前段晶圓製造，台中廠有先進 DRAM、HBM 與封裝測試。工會幹部參與行動的實際規模，不能直接推算成整座晶圓廠停產時間。
text.en: Taoyuan is linked to front-end DRAM manufacturing, while Taichung covers advanced DRAM, HBM and packaging/test. Participation by union officers does not establish a fab-wide shutdown or a specific wafer loss.

text.zh: 美光管理階層表示本次協議新增季度分潤，現金部分於每季財報後發放，股票獎勵一年後歸屬。公司亦公布輪班津貼和結構性調薪調整，桃園工會仍要求持續對話。
text.en: Micron management said cash payments will follow quarterly results while equity vests after one year. The company also described shift-allowance and salary changes, while Taoyuan union representatives maintained negotiations remain open.

text.zh: 未公布工廠產能利用率、實際出貨損失、桃園工會是否接受新方案及台中協議條款全文。
text.en: No fab utilization, shipment loss, Taoyuan union acceptance or full Taichung settlement terms were disclosed.

title.zh: Reuters：台積電洽詢稀土替代馬達，仍屬供應商早期評估
title.en: Reuters: TSMC explores rare-earth-free fab motors in early supplier discussions

summary.zh: Reuters 10 月 22 日引述 3 名知情人士指出，台積電正調查半導體自動化設備使用低稀土或無稀土馬達的可能性，以降低部分設備供應受出口管制影響。報導指出供應商洽詢尚處早期，未有廣泛導入；台積電拒絕評論。
summary.en: Reuters reported on October 22, citing three informed sources, that TSMC is surveying suppliers about alternatives to rare-earth-containing motors in automated fab equipment. Discussions remain preliminary with no broad rollout, and TSMC declined comment.

text.zh: 稀土永磁材料可用於精密定位與自動化設備馬達，連結晶圓廠產線零組件與設備維護。報導所述風險來源為中國既有稀土及磁材出口管制，尚無特定台積電產線因短缺停工的證據。
text.en: Rare-earth permanent magnets support motors used in precision positioning and industrial automation equipment. The reported exposure concerns existing Chinese export controls; there is no identified TSMC production outage attributable to a shortage.

text.zh: Reuters 另引述工研院聲明，台灣正與經濟部產業技術司規劃稀土相關技術專案。工研院過去提及試量產線及供應目標屬先前政策背景，不能視為 10 月 22 日新增產能。
text.en: Reuters also cited ITRI's statement that it is planning a rare-earth technology project with Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs. Earlier pilot-line and supply ambitions are policy background, not new production installed on October 22.

text.zh: 未取得台積電直接公告，無供應商、馬達規格、設備替換數量或導入時間表；屬報導引述的評估。
text.en: No direct TSMC statement, named vendors, motor specifications, replacement volumes or implementation schedule were obtained; the initiative remains source-limited reporting.

title.zh: NVIDIA 推出 DSX POD 模組化 AI 機房，鴻海與台灣 ODM 列合作供應商
title.en: NVIDIA launches DSX POD modular AI factories with Taiwan ODM partners

summary.zh: NVIDIA 10 月 21 日在德國柏林公布以 Vera Rubin 為核心的 DSX POD 模組化 AI 工廠參考設計，合作廠商包括鴻海鴻佰、台達電、技嘉、和碩、雲達及緯創。NVIDIA 稱已備妥現場基礎設施的案場部署可由 6 個月縮短至最快 14 天，全球合作交付目標為 2027 年初。
summary.en: At GTC Berlin on October 21, NVIDIA introduced the Vera Rubin-based DSX POD modular AI-factory reference design, naming Foxconn Ingrasys, Delta, GIGABYTE, Pegatron, QCT and Wistron among its partners. NVIDIA estimates deployment at a prepared site could fall from six months to as little as 14 days, with partner deliveries targeted for early 2027.

text.zh: DSX POD 將伺服器整機、配線、機櫃電源、網路與液冷管路的整合測試提前在工廠完成；交付後仍須案場電力、散熱與網路就緒。台灣合作廠商分布在 ODM、電源與機櫃系統。
text.en: DSX POD preintegrates compute, rack power, networking, cabling and liquid-cooling systems before shipment. Operating sites still need prepared electrical, cooling and network infrastructure; the Taiwan partner list spans ODM, power and rack integration.

text.zh: 所稱 14 天為 NVIDIA 參考設計在已備妥案場條件下的最快目標，6 個月為其比較情境，非所有專案實績。公司未列個別台廠供貨量與認證時程。
text.en: The 14-day figure is NVIDIA's best-case estimate for prepared sites, compared with its six-month reference case, not average project performance. Volumes and qualification schedules for individual Taiwan partners were not disclosed.

text.zh: 個別客戶訂單、機櫃實際額定電力、液冷驗收、部署現場、交付數量均未公布。
text.en: Customer orders, rack-rated power, liquid-cooling acceptance, installation sites and shipment counts were not disclosed.

title.zh: 馬來西亞 SkyeChip 與日本 SAIMEMORY 合作 ZAM 新型 AI 記憶體設計
title.en: Malaysia's SkyeChip joins Japan's SAIMEMORY ZAM memory design program

summary.zh: 日本 SAIMEMORY 與馬來西亞 SkyeChip 於 10 月 21 日宣布設計工程合作，由 SkyeChip 提供記憶體介面、矽晶片設計及客製化 IP，參與面向 AI 資料中心的 Z-Angle Memory（ZAM）開發。官方公告未提供原型測試結果、記憶體頻寬或量產時程。
summary.en: Japan's SAIMEMORY and Malaysia's SkyeChip announced a design-engineering engagement on October 21 for Z-Angle Memory (ZAM) targeting AI data centers. SkyeChip will contribute silicon design, memory-interface engineering and custom IP; prototype validation, bandwidth and commercialization dates were not disclosed.

text.zh: SAIMEMORY 為 SoftBank 旗下技術公司，ZAM 定位為高容量、高頻寬及降低功耗的記憶體架構；SkyeChip 提供 IP 設計、驗證與整合能力。這是新型記憶體研發合作，尚未等同 HBM 產線建成。
text.en: SAIMEMORY is a SoftBank subsidiary developing a high-capacity, high-bandwidth memory architecture; SkyeChip provides memory IP design and integration. This is a development engagement, without evidence of a completed HBM manufacturing line.

text.zh: 合作在日本 NEDO 補助的 Post-5G 基礎設施研發計畫下進行。官方公告著重工程支援與未來商業化意向，未披露交付規格和產線資本支出。
text.en: The work is associated with a Japan NEDO-subsidized Post-5G infrastructure R&D project. The statement covers engineering support and eventual commercialization intentions, without product specifications or fab investment figures.

text.zh: ZAM 原型良率、傳輸頻寬、功耗測試、客戶樣品及商業量產日期尚未公布。
text.en: ZAM prototype yield, bandwidth, measured power, customer samples and volume-production timing remain unknown.

title.zh: 台綜院：9 月半導體用電首破 45 億度，年增 11.55%
title.en: Taiwan semiconductor electricity use exceeds 4.5B kWh in September, up 11.55%

summary.zh: 台灣綜合研究院 10 月 21 日公布，2026 年 9 月台灣半導體業用電量首次突破 45 億度，較去年同期增加 11.55%；製造業高壓以上用電年增 1.96%。台綜院預估全年半導體用電超過 500 億度，屬研究機構估計，並非全年已發生實績。
summary.en: Taiwan Research Institute reported on October 21 that September semiconductor electricity use exceeded 4.5 billion kWh for the first time, up 11.55% year-on-year; high-voltage manufacturing use rose 1.96%. Its full-year semiconductor electricity estimate above 50 billion kWh is a projection, not realized consumption.

text.zh: 半導體用電涵蓋晶圓、封裝與公用廠務負載，可作為生產活動的間接參考，但用電升高亦可能來自新廠試產、設備配置與能效因素，不能直接換算晶圓出貨。
text.en: Semiconductor electricity consumption reflects wafer fabs, packaging and utilities, but can also change with commissioning, operating mix and energy efficiency. It should not be converted directly into wafer output.

text.zh: 台綜院同時公布 9 月全國高壓以上產業用電年增 1.76%，半導體分項年增 11.55%；其 2026 全年 500 億度估計尚待後續實際統計驗證。
text.en: The institute also reported a 1.76% rise in nationwide high-voltage industrial consumption for September, compared with 11.55% for semiconductors. Its full-year estimate remains subject to later statistics.

text.zh: 未取得研究院原始月報表，各產業用電分項基期度數、個別廠區負載及全年實際用量無法核對。
text.en: The underlying institute data table was not directly obtained; sector base consumption, individual fab loads and full-year actual consumption remain unavailable.

title.zh: 馬國國會披露半導體培訓核准 4,767 萬令吉，涵蓋 1.9 萬名額
title.en: Malaysia reports RM47.67M semiconductor training approvals covering 19,084 places

summary.zh: 馬來西亞貿工部長 10 月 22 日經媒體報導向國會指出，HRD Corp 已於 8 月核准 4,767 萬令吉高科技培訓補助，涵蓋 19,084 個名額及 9 類半導體相關技能。截至 2026 年第 3 季，累計已有 22,849 名勞工完成各項相關訓練；這些數字各屬不同統計期間，不能直接相減作為未完成名額。
summary.en: Malaysia's trade minister told parliament in reporting published October 22 that HRD Corp had approved RM47.67 million in August for 19,084 training places across nine semiconductor-related skills. A separate tally reported 22,849 trained workers by Q3 2026; the figures have different periods and populations and are not directly subtractable.

text.zh: 培訓項目涵蓋 IC 設計、先進封裝、自動化及數位技術，是國家半導體策略人力供給的一環。2030 年 6 萬名高技能工程師是政策目標，不能視為已受訓人數。
text.en: The programs span IC design, advanced packaging, automation and digital technology under Malaysia's National Semiconductor Strategy. The goal of 60,000 high-skilled engineers by 2030 is a target, not a delivered headcount.

text.zh: 依 The Star 引述，款項是在 2026 年 8 月獲核准；10 月 22 日的新資訊為國會披露最新累計訓練進度。官方國會紀錄及核准項目細表未取得。
text.en: The Star reported the grant approval occurred in August 2026; the October 22 development is parliamentary disclosure of cumulative training progress. Original Hansard records and line-item approvals were not available.
